name: prism-image-viewer
description: A local Electron image viewer with WebGL2 rendering and broad native decoding

scripts.lint: bun x --bun --no-install biome lint --error-on-warnings src scripts test
scripts.lint:fix: bun x --bun --no-install biome lint --write src scripts test
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun scripts/check-version.ts
scripts.package:windows: bun node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64 --prepackaged dist/Prism-win32-x64 --publish never

author: jedace07
